# Christian Elías Cruz González

> Personal site of Christian Elías Cruz González — software engineer, speaker, and author. Content is available in Spanish (default, at the root), English (/en/), and Latin (/lat/). All structured data is also exposed through a public JSON API.

## API (preferred for machines)

- [API index](https://christianecg.com/api/index.json): directory of every JSON endpoint
- [Profile](https://christianecg.com/api/profile.json): role, location, links, CVs in three languages
- [Timeline](https://christianecg.com/api/timeline.json): career milestones from 2018 to today
- [Talks](https://christianecg.com/api/talks.json): talks, keynotes, mentorships, media appearances
- [Papers](https://christianecg.com/api/papers.json): published academic papers
- [Projects](https://christianecg.com/api/projects.json): side projects and products with stack tags
- [Articles](https://christianecg.com/api/articles.json): blog articles and external feed
- [Press](https://christianecg.com/api/press.json): press kits, assets, and media mentions

## Pages

- [Home](https://christianecg.com/): who I am and what I do
- [Blog](https://christianecg.com/blog/): articles and essays
- [CV](https://christianecg.com/cv/): full curriculum vitae
- [Timeline](https://christianecg.com/timeline/): career milestones
- [Now](https://christianecg.com/now/): what I'm focused on right now
- [Manifiesto](https://christianecg.com/manifiesto/): personal manifesto
- [Colophon](https://christianecg.com/colophon/): how this site is built
- [Talks](https://christianecg.com/talks/): speaking engagements
- [Press](https://christianecg.com/press/): press kit and mentions

## Feeds

- [RSS](https://christianecg.com/rss.xml): blog RSS feed
- [JSON Feed](https://christianecg.com/feed.json): blog JSON feed
